'''Hickory Corners''' is a [[census-designated place]] (CDP) in [[Barry Township, Michigan|Barry Township]] in [[Barry County, Michigan|Barry County]], [[Michigan]], United States. The population was 313 at the 2020 census.

==History==
The first settler, the Rev. Moses Lawrence, built his home in 1834 on the shore of Lawrence Lake about a half mile east of the present town. In 1837, surveyors found a large [[hickory]] tree in the center of [[section (United States land surveying)|section]] 28, from which the settlement took its name. Solomon C. Hall built the first house in the town and became the first postmaster in July 1844.<ref name="Romig">{{cite book | last = Romig | first = Walter  | year = 1986 | title = Michigan Place Names | orig-year= 1973 | publisher = Wayne State University Press | location = Detroit, Michigan | isbn = 0-8143-1838-X}}</ref>

==Geography==
Hickory Corners is located in southwestern Barry County at the intersection of Kellogg School Road and West Hickory Road. It is {{convert|1.5|mi}} north of the southern boundary of Barry County with [[Kalamazoo County, Michigan|Kalamazoo County]] and {{convert|2.5|mi}} east of state highway [[M-43 (Michigan highway)|M-43]].

According to the [[United States Census Bureau]], the Hickory Corners CDP has a total area of {{convert|5.4|sqkm|disp=flip}}, of which {{convert|0.01|sqkm|disp=flip|3}}, or 0.28%, is water.<ref name="Census 2010">{{Cite web| url=http://factfinder.census.gov/bkmk/table/1.0/en/DEC/10_DP/G001/1600000US2637960| archive-url=https://archive.today/20200212193754/http://factfinder.census.gov/bkmk/table/1.0/en/DEC/10_DP/G001/1600000US2637960| url-status=dead| archive-date=February 12, 2020| title=Geographic Identifiers: 2010 Demographic Profile Data (G001): Hickory Corners CDP, Michigan| publisher=U.S. Census Bureau, American Factfinder| access-date=December 23, 2013}}</ref>

==Sites of interest==
{{Unreferenced section|date=January 2023}}
The [[Gilmore Car Museum]], a collection of classic automobiles, is located at the intersection of M-43 and West Hickory Road, with a Hickory Corners mailing address. The museum includes the [[Michigan Motor Sports Hall of Fame]].

The [[Kellogg Biological Station]], an off-campus education complex of [[Michigan State University]], has a Hickory Corners mailing address and is located {{convert|3|mi|0}} southwest of the center of town, on the northeast shore of [[Gull Lake (Michigan)|Gull Lake]].

==Media==
{{Unreferenced section|date=January 2023}}
On the [[CBS]] TV series ''[[The Neighborhood (TV series)|The Neighborhood]]'', the character Gemma is from Hickory Corners. Her husband, Dave, is from [[Kalamazoo, Michigan|East Kalamazoo]].
